name: Buzz Tools
tagline: A small, free set of utilities that run entirely in your browser — no accounts, no installs, and none of your input ever leaves your machine.

tools.name: Word Unscrambler
tools.description: Type any set of letters and instantly see every word you can spell with them — longest first, space-separated.

tools.name: Word Scrambler
tools.description: Enter any word or phrase and scramble its letters — perfect for puzzles, games, or brain-teasers.

tools.name: Word to HTML Converter
tools.description: Paste content from Word, Google Docs, or any rich-text source and get clean, semantic HTML — no inline styles, no mso cruft.

tools.name: Sample Size Calculator
tools.description: Determine the minimum sample size needed for surveys and experiments — with optional finite population correction.

tools.name: Margin of Error Calculator
tools.description: Calculate the margin of error and confidence interval for survey results and sample data.

tools.name: QR Code Generator
tools.description: Generate QR codes with custom styling — choose module shape, colours, error correction level, add a logo, and export as PNG, SVG, JPEG or WebP.

tools.name: Markdown ↔ HTML Converter
tools.description: Convert Markdown to HTML and back — a GFM subset with live preview, semantic output, and nothing leaving your browser.
